identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational radiopharmaceutical ligand name as reported in limited public sources.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: A lutetium-177-labeled PSMA-targeting radioligand designed to bind prostate-specific membrane antigen on prostate cancer cells and deliver beta radiation to PSMA-expressing tissue.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Targeted binding to PSMA followed by internalization and localized beta-particle irradiation from lutetium-177, causing DNA damage and tumor cell death.
downstream_effects: Cross-fire irradiation of nearby PSMA-expressing cells
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Intended selectivity for PSMA-expressing tumors; physiologic uptake is also expected in normal PSMA-expressing tissues such as salivary glands and kidneys, but agent-specific selectivity data for VG01 were not identified.

clinical_settings: Investigational use in PSMA-expressing advanced prostate cancer
typical_use.scope: Not established as standard of care; public evidence appears limited to investigational development.

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Expected on-target radiation exposure in PSMA-expressing salivary tissue for PSMA radioligands as a class; VG01-specific quantified human incidence not identified.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Class-based inference; not confirmed with agent-specific mechanistic publication

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Expected marrow irradiation from circulating/activity-distributed radioligand therapy as a class; VG01-specific quantified human incidence not identified.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Class-based inference; not confirmed with agent-specific mechanistic publication

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Expected renal handling and physiologic PSMA-associated uptake for PSMA radioligands as a class; VG01-specific quantified human incidence not identified.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Class-based inference; not confirmed with agent-specific mechanistic publication
